author: SARTHAK GANGOPADHYAY
description: Bengal's voters, including Mukherjees and Banerjees, face hearings over "logical discrepancies" in surnames. The Election Commission's software flags historical variations like Mukhopadhyay for Mukherjee, a simplification by the British. Many now prefer shorter versions, leading to confusion and summons, prompting criticism from CM Mamata Banerjee about cultural insensitivity.
title: Bengali? Yes, SIR. Brahmin? Yes, SIR. Go, fall in line

author: RAUNAK BOSE
description: The Yankees are poised to spend big on a veteran bat, potentially impacting top prospects Jasson Dominguez and Spencer Jones.  With an outfield crowded by established stars, these young talents might be traded to contenders seeking high-upside talent. This move signals New York's win-now mentality, prioritizing immediate impact over long-term development.
title: MLB trade rumors: Yankees likely to move on from power-hitting duo

author: etimes.in
description: Actor Kamaal Rashid Khan, also known as KRK, was reportedly arrested on Saturday in connection with a firing incident. He allegedly admitted to firing two rounds from his licensed firearm at a residential building in Mumbai's Oshiwara area on January 18. No casualties were reported in the incident.
title: Actor Kamaal R Khan arrested by Mumbai police for firing incident at residential building

author: TOI TECH DESK
description: Arc Raiders is experiencing a widespread global outage, impacting players since January 24, 2026. Thousands are reporting server connection failures, login issues, and matchmaking errors. Despite many being unable to play, live data shows a significant number of active users online, though with limited functionality. Developers have yet to issue an official statement.
title: Arc Raiders faces global outage, players report matchmaking issues

author: TOI WORLD DESK
description: A devastating family dispute in Lawrenceville, Georgia, tragically claimed the lives of four adults, including an Indian national, early Friday. Three children, who bravely hid and alerted authorities, survived the horrific incident. The alleged shooter, identified as Vijay Kumar, has been arrested and faces multiple charges.
title: Children hid in closet: Indian national, 3 relatives shot dead in family dispute in US

author: BIJU BABU CYRIAC
description: World Cup 2026 attendees can expect faster US visas. Brand USA is facilitating the process for ticket holders. Curated experiences like road trips on Route 66 are planned. Indian travelers will find familiar communities in host cities like New Jersey and New York. AI tools will assist in planning multi-city itineraries for the event.
title: Fast-tracked visas await 2026 T20 World Cup fans

author: TOI NEWS DESK
description: Tamil Nadu chief minister MK Stalin sharply criticized governor RN Ravi in the state assembly, accusing him of undermining constitutional conventions by refusing to read his customary address. Stalin highlighted the Dravidian model government's achievements and dismissed law and order concerns.
title: ‘Not inferior to anyone in patriotism’: Stalin hits out at TN governor, says no one needs to teach us

author: BARINDERJIT SALUJA
description: A suspected sabotage incident rocked the Amritsar-Delhi railway line in Punjab late Friday night. An explosion near Khanpur village, Fatehgarh Sahib, damaged approximately 12 feet of track, injuring a freight train's loco pilot. Authorities are investigating the blast, which occurred around 12:30 am Saturday. Restoration efforts are underway with enhanced security.
title: Sabotage? Explosion damages Amritsar–Delhi railway line in Fatehgarh Sahib; loco pilot injured

author: TOI WORLD DESK
description: The UAE has released over 900 Indian prisoners as part of a humanitarian pardon ordered by President Sheikh Mohamed bin Zayed Al Nahyan. This significant gesture, coinciding with National Day celebrations, includes the clearing of financial penalties, enabling a genuine fresh start for the inmates. The release strengthens the deep-rooted brotherhood and goodwill between the UAE and India.
title: UAE orders release for 900+ Indian prisoners ahead of National Day

author: TOI WORLD DESK
title: Wedding horror in Pakistan: 7 killed, 25 injured after suicide bomber targets marriage ceremony

author: ROSY SEQUEIRA
description: Bombay High Court has sternly criticized the BMC for its lax approach to Mumbai's pollution control, threatening to withhold the municipal commissioner's salary. Judges noted a lack of sincere effort and a "belligerent disregard" for court orders, particularly regarding Navi Mumbai's affidavit. This strong stance signals a potential financial penalty for non-compliance.
title: Will stop BMC chief’s salary if AQI doesn’t improve: Bombay HC

author: TOI Education
description: Canada is expanding academic engagement with India as Indians face headwinds in the US higher education system. Universities Canada will lead 21 Canadian university presidents on a multi-city India mission to explore research collaboration, academic exchange and transnational education. The initiative aligns with renewed bilateral ties, CEPA negotiations, Canada’s $1.7-billion research strategy and upcoming high-level visits, strengthening long-term education, research and industry partnerships across government, academia and innovation ecosystems in both countries over coming years.
title: Canada offers research lifeline to Indian talent amid US headwinds in higher education drive

author: TOI CITY DESK
description: Delhi experienced clear skies on Saturday after Friday's heavy rainfall, bringing a slight improvement in air quality to the 'poor' category. Moderate fog and strong winds are expected, with minimum temperatures anticipated to fall by 5-6°C over the next three days. Despite the rain, air quality remained poor across several city areas.
title: Delhi AQI at 256 in ‘poor’ category; visibility improves, minimum temperatures to drop 5–6°C over next 3 days

author: MAITREE BARAL
description: Weekend-only drinking, often perceived as responsible, can still significantly harm the liver. Experts emphasize that the amount and speed of alcohol consumption, rather than the number of alcohol-free days, are key factors in liver damage. This pattern can lead to silent, progressive liver disease, especially for those with pre-existing health conditions.
title: Do alcohol-free ‘only weekend drinking’ habits still damage the liver?

author: PATHIKRIT CHAKRABORTY
description: A Mirzapur gym syndicate was busted for an illegal religious conversion and AI-backed blackmail racket targeting up to 30 women. The gang created AI-generated obscene videos of Hindu women to coerce them into religious conversion and sexual exploitation. Six accused, including a police constable, have been arrested.
title: Gym syndicate in UP targeted Hindu women for conversion; GRP head constable among 6 held

author: TOI CITY DESK
description: A Mumbai woman alleges she was assaulted by a massage therapist from an app-based service after cancelling a session midway due to discomfort. The therapist reportedly became enraged, verbally abused, and physically attacked the 46-year-old victim in Wadala. Police are investigating the incident, with a video of the event circulating online.
title: Masseuse assaults woman for cancelling treatment in Mumbai's Wadala; video goes viral

author: ADVITYA BAHL
description: A non-bailable warrant has been issued for Lotus Greens founder Nirmal Singh in connection with the drowning death of engineer Yuvraj Mehta. Singh is absconding, with police warning of property attachment if he doesn't surrender. He faces charges under environmental acts and BNS sections for negligence and public nuisance.
title: Noida techie death: Non-bailable warrant against plot shareholder Nirmal Singh

author: ADVITYA BAHL
description: A 20-year-old BTech student, Udit Soni, died after jumping from the fourth floor of EZ Stays hostel in Greater Noida. Police reported the incident occurred after the hostel manager scolded him for returning drunk. Authorities have taken custody of the body and are investigating the circumstances.
title: 'Scolded for returning drunk': BTech student dies after jumping from Greater Noida hostel

author: TOI WORLD DESK
description: President Trump is intensifying his focus on Greenland, with the White House releasing an AI-generated image of him with a penguin to highlight the strategic importance of the Arctic island. Trump has cited security concerns regarding Russia and China, sparking backlash from allies. He also criticized Canada's opposition to a missile defense project, warning of Chinese influence.
title: Still eyeing the Arctic? White House posts AI image of Trump with penguin in Greenland

author: TOI WORLD DESK
description: Iran has issued a stern warning, stating any attack will be treated as an all-out war, amid the deployment of a US aircraft carrier strike group and other military assets to the Middle East. Tehran's military is on high alert, prepared for the worst-case scenario as tensions escalate following US-backed Israeli strikes and President Trump's close watch on Iran.
title: 'Surgical, kinetic ... ': Iran warns US of ‘all-out war’ over ‘military build-up’ in Middle East

author: BARSHA DUTTA
description: Donna Kelce shared a Times Square billboard promoting a new Kelce brothers project tied to their New Heights podcast, drawing attention as Travis Kelce weighs retirement. While remaining quiet about his NFL future, Travis continues expanding his off field ventures. A recent excited comment about the Chiefs’ coaching move has further fueled speculation that he may return next season.
title: Donna Kelce sparks Travis Kelce retirement rumors, wedding plans on hold

author: TOI BUSINESS DESK
description: India's precious metal refiners are urging the government to address duty disparities that disadvantage local operations compared to imported refined bullion. MMTC-PAMP highlights a mismatch in import duties, particularly through the SEPA route, impacting domestic refiners' competitiveness. The industry seeks policy support, including input-related benefits and wider duty differentials, to bolster India's refining capacity and global standing.
title: Budget 2026 metal sector expectations: MMTC-PAMP pushes for duty parity for refiners

author: TOI WORLD DESK
description: US President Donald Trump criticized Canada for opposing his "Golden Dome" missile defense system over Greenland, accusing Ottawa of prioritizing economic ties with China. Trump asserted Canada's security relies on the US, a claim rejected by Canadian PM Mark Carney, who emphasized Canadian sovereignty and thriving independently. The dispute highlights ongoing bilateral tensions and differing approaches to international relations.
title: ‘China will eat them up’: Trump slams Canada over pushback on ‘Golden Dome’ plan in Greenland

author: CHAITANYA MARPAKWAR AND CHITTARANJAN TEMBHEKAR
description: Thackeray cousins shared a stage, expressing dismay over Maharashtra's political 'auctions' and defections. Raj Thackeray called the situation 'disgusting,' while Uddhav Thackeray vowed to 'start afresh' after BMC polls, criticizing those trying to erase the 'Thackeray' name and alleging money played a role in elections. Both emphasized continuing Balasaheb's legacy.
title: ‘It’s good Balasaheb isn’t here, he would have been distressed’: Raj Thackeray on Maharashtra’s current scenario

author: NITASHA NATU
description: Actor Kamaal R Khan was arrested by Mumbai Police in connection with a firing incident at a housing society. Two bullets were reportedly fired, leaving impact marks but no casualties. Police are investigating the motive behind the event and have taken Khan into custody for interrogation.
title: Kamaal R Khan held after shots fired inside Andheri West residential complex

author: CHAITANYA MARPAKWAR
description: Deputy CM Eknath Shinde lauded MNS chief Raj Thackeray for his broader perspective and support for development, noting MNS corporators' backing in KDMC. Shinde emphasized the Mahayuti's strength, including the MNS, and stated the BMC mayor's post will be from their alliance, not for those lacking numbers.
title: 'Never looked at personal gain': Eknath Shinde praises Raj Thackeray for 'helping hand' in Kalyan-Dombivli

author: GLOBAL SPORTS DESK
description: ​ J.T. Realmuto and his wife, Alexis, had a relaxing family photo that instantly hit a chord with the fans. The image was shot in a relaxed setting on a peaceful beach background with soft and neutral color, which provided a feeling of comfort and unity between the family. As fans reacted warmly to the post, one comment stood out for its familiarity and humor. Nick Castellanos’ wife, Jessica Castellanos, shared a response that blended affection with an easy sense of fun.
title: Nick Castellanos’ wife Jessica’s comment adds charm to Realmuto’s family moment

author: TOI SPORTS DESK
description: Actor-producer Vidnyan Mane has accused singer-composer Palaash Muchhal of infidelity and financial misconduct, leading to a police complaint in Sangli, Maharashtra. Mane alleges Muchhal was caught with another woman during wedding festivities and claims he was cheated of over Rs 40 lakh in a film project. Muchhal has denied all accusations, calling them baseless and factually incorrect.
title: 'Palash Muchhal was caught red-handed': Smriti Mandhana's childhood friend makes big claim

author: TOI SPORTS DESK
description: Suryakumar Yadav lauded Ishan Kishan's fearless batting after India's seven-wicket win over New Zealand.  Kishan's aggressive 76 and Yadav's 82 powered a remarkable chase, reflecting the team's desired free-flowing approach. Despite bowling struggles, the team restricted New Zealand to a manageable total.
title: Revealed! Why Suryakumar Yadav was angry at Ishan Kishan

author: TOI SPORTS DESK
description: Ishan Kishan's powerful 76 off 32 balls marked a triumphant return to the Indian jersey after a two-year hiatus.  He rediscovered his form through domestic cricket, answering his own doubts about his capability to perform at the international level.  Kishan's confident mindset and strategic approach were key to chasing a daunting target.
title: The question that brought Ishan Kishan back: 'Can I do it or not?'

author: TOI WORLD DESK
description: A colossal winter tempest is wreaking havoc across a significant portion of the United States, bringing with it an onslaught of freezing rain and subzero Arctic air. Meteorologists are alerting residents that the storm might cause devastation akin to hurricane-force conditions. With life-threatening wind chills becoming common, the risk of frostbite looms large.
title: US braces for historic winter storm; power outage risks mount, flights cancelled

author: TOI WORLD DESK
title: Why thousands of onions appeared on Brighton beach after Storm Goretti

author: NIRUPA VATYAM
description: Approximately 300 dog carcasses were discovered in a pit in Jagtial district, Telangana, following alleged mass killings. Animal rights activists claim the incident occurred on Thursday, reportedly on the village sarpanch's orders. Police have registered an FIR against the sarpanch and gram panchayat secretary under relevant sections of the BNS and PCA Act.
title: 300 more killed, Telangana dog toll 900 in a month; sarpanch named in FIR

author: TOI ENTERTAINMENT DESK
description: 'Border 2' has made a powerful debut at the box office, exceeding expectations with an impressive Rs 30 crore net collection on its opening day. The war drama, starring Sunny Deol, secured a significant Rs 17 crore in advance bookings, positioning it among the highest first-day collections in Bollywood history.
title: 'Border 2' box office collections Day 1: Sunny Deol starrer earns Rs 30 crore

author: NIKHIL SHARMA
description: A Faridabad father, Krishna Jaiswal, has been arrested for allegedly beating his four-and-a-half-year-old daughter to death with a rolling pin and slamming her on the floor. The brutal assault reportedly occurred because the child struggled with her numbers. The father initially tried to conceal the crime by claiming she fell.
title: ‘Failed to write 1 to 50’: Father beats child to death with rolling pin in Faridabad

author: TOI ENTERTAINMENT DESK
description: 'Dhurandhar' marks 50 days at the box office, but with its lowest collection yet at Rs 55 lakh. Despite a strong run, the film's earnings dipped significantly in its eighth week. While its total net earnings are Rs 831.5 crore, it faces stiff competition, with 'Border 2' now posing a challenge.
title: 'Dhurandhar' crashes on day 50 after 'Border 2' release

author: TOI SPORTS DESK
description: Bangladesh's cricket board faces a potential crisis as the national team might withdraw from the T20 World Cup over security and national prestige concerns. This decision, linked to BCB president Aminul Islam Bulbul, could cost the country millions in lost revenue and impact future tours. Players, while assured of match fees, miss a crucial global platform.
title: T20 WC row: Bangladesh stare at major financial hit; set to lose millions of dollars

author: TOI SPORTS DESK
description: Teams withdrawing from ICC events due to security and political concerns is a recurring issue. Notable instances include Australia and West Indies in 1996, England and New Zealand in 2003, Zimbabwe in 2009, Australia in 2016, and India's refusal to tour Pakistan in 2025. These decisions have significantly impacted major tournaments.
title: When teams said no: A look at ICC tournaments hit by refusals and withdrawals

author: KUSHAGRA DIXIT
description: New Delhi experienced its highest single-day rainfall in January in three years on Friday, with 13.2 mm recorded. Overcast skies and gusty winds kept temperatures unusually high for the minimum and low for the maximum. While a dip in minimum temperatures is expected, coldwave conditions are unlikely.
title: Will rain continue in Delhi-NCR? IMD forecasts dip in minimum temperature

author: TOI TECH DESK
title: ‘Peace or piece of Greenland?’: Elon Musk ‘mocks’ Donald Trump’s Board of Peace at Davos

author: TOI TECH DESK
description: Video platform Vimeo is reportedly conducting significant global layoffs following its acquisition by Bending Spoons. This marks the second round of job cuts for Vimeo this year, impacting a large portion of its workforce. Former VP Dave Brown confirmed his departure, citing the sudden nature of the layoffs after the company's recent purchase.
title: Vimeo Layoffs: YouTube rival slashes global staff; move after $1.38bn deal

author: TNN
description: South district police arrested a Nigerian national, Emmanuel, allegedly a kingpin in a synthetic drug operation. A "chemical kitchen" was discovered in his Devli residence, a factory for manufacturing high-end psychotropic substances like MDMA and heroin. The bust yielded 113 kg of raw materials, indicating local production and potential international cartel links.
title: 'Chemical kitchen': South Delhi police uncover major synthetic narcotics lab, arrest Nigerian national

author: KRISHNA CHAUDHARY
description: An FIR has been registered in Moradabad against five minor Muslim girls. They are accused of making their 16-year-old Hindu friend wear a burqa. The incident occurred on December 12, 2025. Police are investigating the matter following a complaint. The law carries a severe punishment for religious conversion by force or fraud.
title: FIR filed against 5 minor girls for allegedly making Hindu friend wear burqa; probe underway

author: NIRUPA VATYAM
description: Over 300 dog carcasses were discovered in a pit in Jagtial district, Telangana, following alleged mass killings. This incident brings the total number of deceased dogs in the state this month to nearly 900. Animal rights activists claim the killings were ordered by the village sarpanch, leading to an FIR against local officials.
title: Telangana: 300 dog carcasses found dumped in Jagtial; mass killing toll rises to 900
